name: ferbtools-extension
description: FerbTools Chrome extension toolkit. Made by Ferb.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && cp -R static/. dist
scripts.build:production: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.pack: npm run build:production && cd dist && zip -r ../ferbtools-production.zip .
scripts.watch: npm run build && (tsc --watch --preserveWatchOutput & node scripts/watch-static.js & wait)
